authorizationScope: Guard hardening and synthetic pilot approved; W1 implementation remains disabled
supersedes: Historical model assignments only: user selects Luna Max execution/Verify/Review and Sol Decision/Integration/Audit/Orchestration
Task contradictions corrected by explicit K1/I1/A1 gates and owner/reopening rules

tasks.title: Reconcile architecture docs and publish proposed W1 queue/graph
tasks.acceptance: Parent/peer documents agree, the prior G3 baseline is reconciled, and the replacement queue/graph are explicitly non-dispatchable.

tasks.title: Owner approval of W1 plan and architecture boundary
verifyCommandsToMaterialize: Explicit approval of the exact proposed queue/graph and non-goals
tasks.acceptance: Plan approval recorded; this gate alone does not authorize code dispatch.

tasks.title: Separate owner authorization to dispatch W1 implementation
tasks.acceptance: Worker tasks may start only after this separate authorization.

tasks.title: Freeze standalone Query IR V1 schema and schema-validation gate
tasks.acceptance: Closed schema validates valid/invalid envelopes and rejects unknown fields; dependency diff is test-only.

tasks.title: Add shared V1 request/response conformance fixture matrix
tasks.acceptance: Fixture containers validate; positive requests are schema-valid, schema-invalid requests are rejected, and valid-but-unsupported requests yield the specified typed error. Never require every negative request to validate.
tasks.reopen: A normative mismatch returns to K1 and a new approved plan revision; revalidate S1 and every dependent task.

tasks.title: Characterize core executor and budget behavior with contract tests
tasks.acceptance: Record every case as expected GREEN or a specifically approved expected RED; RED acceptance is characterization only, never an integrated GREEN result.

tasks.title: Apply minimal core corrections only for verified C0 failures
tasks.acceptance: Core contract tests pass; every behavior change has an evidence-backed RCA and remains within accepted V1.

tasks.title: Test HQL compatibility and route production findings to the source owner
verifyCommandsToMaterialize: cargo test --locked --no-default-features --test hql_p0_tests --test hql_collection_tests --test hql_cypher_tests --test wave_e_context_tests
tasks.acceptance: Existing HQL supported paths preserve semantics; legacy fallback behavior remains intact.

tasks.title: Verify REST request/result/error-envelope conformance
tasks.acceptance: REST matches the accepted schema, capability declarations, typed failures, and core results.
tasks.fixtureOwner: F1; reopening creates a revised plan and invalidates dependent evidence; R1 cannot edit shared fixtures

tasks.title: Verify N-API and TypeScript conformance after HQL/REST baselines
tasks.acceptance: N-API results/errors match REST and TypeScript declarations accurately describe discriminated operation/result envelopes; generated artifacts are freshness-checked.

tasks.title: Audit declared SDK and MCP consumer support (evidence-only)
tasks.acceptance: Record supported, partial, unsupported, and NOT_RUN per consumer; do not add adapter scope or modify SDK/MCP files in this task.

tasks.title: Integrated Verify Gate on one immutable candidate SHA
tasks.acceptance: All required gates pass on the same candidate SHA; every skip/failure is explained and cannot be promoted to PASS.

tasks.title: Independent architecture and diff Review Gate
verifyCommandsToMaterialize: Review changed files, acceptance mapping, task write sets, and exact Verify evidence
tasks.acceptance: Independent Luna Max Review on the exact integrated candidate, after Verify PASS; no author or integrator self-review.

tasks.title: Reconcile final implementation and evidence into canonical docs
tasks.acceptance: Freeze normative docs, scope and expected evidence inventory before integration; record final PASS and run receipts outside the candidate tree.

tasks.title: Final Gate: acceptance, provenance, scope, and merge readiness
verifyCommandsToMaterialize: Recheck acceptance criteria, immutable candidate SHA, Verify PASS, Astra Review PASS, docs consistency, and merge-order compliance
tasks.acceptance: Fresh independent Verify, Review, final Audit and integration receipts bind one candidate; all required AC pass and no blocking findings remain. Completion does not authorize merge or release.

tasks.title: Resolve normative contracts and enumerate case-level AC
tasks.acceptance: Pin each bound/default/error mapping and expected outcome before S1; every case has a required flag and exact command identity.

tasks.title: Assemble immutable candidate and integration provenance
tasks.acceptance: Record ordered task commits, tree/source digests and atomic C0+C1 GREEN closure; no unverified generated or documentation changes remain.

tasks.title: Independent final scope and provenance audit
tasks.acceptance: Separate Sol session checks effective AC, source and artifact hashes, all receipts, scope and remaining NOT_RUN items; consumer audit X1 cannot substitute.

acceptance.criterion: A standalone closed Draft 2020-12 schema and shared fixtures define supported V1 envelopes without widening approved semantics.
Existing supported operation behavior is tested against the accepted schema and truthful capability declarations across core, HQL, REST, and N-API.
Unsupported capabilities, including relational_named_query, reject explicitly with stable typed errors and without semantic degradation.
Bounds, defaults, capability reporting, and error mappings in the shared fixtures are sourced from explicit contract decisions rather than inferred implementation values.
Existing HQL fallback behavior remains unchanged unless an accepted test proves a contract mismatch.
Focused and full required tests pass on the same candidate SHA; skipped work is reported as unverified.
Independent Luna Max Review and separate Sol final provenance/scope Audit pass on the integrated candidate; canonical docs and external receipts identify evidence and remaining NOT_RUN items.
W1 claims conformance only for verified surfaces; the overall accepted spec remains partial while broader SDK/MCP/NL-adapter gates remain incomplete.

materializationBlocks: Record owner W1 scope and dispatch authorization for the exact immutable execution plan
K1 resolves per-case normative decisions and maps required AC to allowlisted executable/argv/cwd commands
Pin baseline/candidate, concrete task and command deadlines, command budgets and all source/artifact identities
Create isolated workspaces and external run ledger; register actual provider session receipts through the trusted coordinator
Compile to SPEC--EXECUTION-DAG-GUARD-V1 closed schema and pass validatePlan before dispatch
